prompt: A platform team runs Redis Cloud Pro across several cloud providers and regions. They want committed spending, significant savings, and Premium support. Which subscription should they choose?
explanation: Redis Cloud Pro annual plans support the same features as pay-as-you-go Pro but at significant savings, include Premium support, and apply a single commitment across multiple providers and regions. Pay-as-you-go Pro offers the same feature set but with no committed term and standard support, while Essentials plans are shared-infrastructure plans without Premium support.

options.text: Two Redis Cloud Essentials subscriptions, one per region
